name: Signature Red Velvet
description: Standardized central production recipe for CakeStory's signature velvety crimson sponge paired with cultured cream cheese frosting.
sopSteps: Sift flour and cocoa powder twice for uniform aeration and clumping prevention.
Emulsify wet ingredients at 180 RPM in central batch mixer.
Fold dry and wet mixtures under 90 seconds to prevent gluten over-development.
Bake in rotary rack oven at 165°C for 28 mins with core temperature probe verification.
Blast chill to 4°C before central cold-chain dispatch to franchise network.

name: Belgian Chocolate Truffle
description: Standardized recipe utilizing 55% Belgian dark chocolate couverture and rich dairy ganache formulated for consistency across all outlets.
sopSteps: Melt couverture chocolate gently in jacketed kettle between 45°C - 48°C.
Emulsify heated cream into chocolate starting from center for ultra-glossy ganache.
Soak sponge layers evenly with 50ml vanilla syrup per layer.
Enrobe in temperature-controlled glaze at 32°C.
Conduct visual gloss inspection and core temperature check before packaging.

name: Lotus Biscoff Delight
description: Central kitchen formulation balancing crunchy speculoos biscuits with creamy caramelized Biscoff spread and whipped mousse.
sopSteps: Layer crushed biscuit base with gentle pneumatic compaction.
Spread warmed Biscoff spread between aerated sponge disks.
Apply whipped dairy frosting with motorized turntable at fixed speed.
Drizzle warmed spread at 30°C for signature drip effect and garnish with whole biscuits.

name: Royal Black Forest
description: Traditional Schwarzwälder formulation featuring tart Maraschino cherries, dark chocolate shavings, and fresh whipped cream.
sopSteps: Level and split chocolate sponge into 3 uniform disks using laser guide.
Infuse cherry reduction syrup evenly across sponge surface.
Pipe fresh whipped cream and distribute chopped cherries uniformly.
Garnish with hand-crafted dark chocolate flakes and whole glazed cherries.

name: Dutch Truffle Gateau
description: Dense, intense cocoa-rich gateau made with Dutch-processed cocoa and heavy ganache glaze for chocolate connoisseurs.
sopSteps: Prepare rich Dutch chocolate emulsion at 50°C.
Infuse layers with dark chocolate nectar.
Smooth enrobe with heated metal spatula at 30°C.
Chill for 2 hours in central refrigeration unit before temperature-controlled logistics dispatch.

name: Fresh Strawberry Cream
description: Seasonal recipe using farm-sourced Mahabaleshwar strawberries and light vanilla chiffon sponge.
sopSteps: Wash and inspect grade-A Mahabaleshwar strawberries under sanitization line.
Cook half portion into natural fruit compote with zero artificial color.
Layer fresh sliced strawberries between fluffy cream and sponge disks.
Top with glazed whole strawberries and chill at 2°C - 4°C.

name: Artisan Butterscotch Crunch
description: Caramelized brown sugar sponge layered with house-made praline crunch and golden caramel drizzle.
sopSteps: Caramelize sugar and roasted cashew nuts for crunchy praline.
Crush praline to 3mm particle size for consistent mouthfeel.
Assemble sponge layers with rich caramel drip and praline spread.
Coat perimeter with golden praline crunch and set in refrigeration.

name: Gulab Jamun Fusion Celebration
description: Fusion recipe combining delicate cardamom saffron sponge, rabdi mousse cream, and soft khoya gulab jamuns.
sopSteps: Drain excess sugar syrup from mini gulab jamuns to maintain sponge moisture balance.
Layer fragrant cardamom sponge with rabdi mousse.
Embed whole mini gulab jamuns symmetrically inside cake core.
Garnish with edible silver leaf and slivered California almonds.

name: Alfonso Mango Bliss
description: Formulated with 100% pure Ratnagiri Alphonso mango pulp and dairy mousse for signature summer indulgence.
sopSteps: Puree fresh Alphonso mangoes with zero added water.
Fold 60% mango pulp into cream for rich mango mousse.
Alternate sponge layers with pulp and fresh diced mango chunks.
Apply mirror mango glaze at 28°C and seal.
